clips.title: The story
paras: Between Razor Hill and Tiragarde Keep, wreckage from Daelin Proudmoore’s fleet litters Durotar’s eastern shore. The sunken ships make the Scuttle Coast a place where the Horde scavenges and remembers the recent naval war.

Sunken warships line Durotar’s eastern edge, where the shore meets the Great Sea. During Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore’s invasion, the Kul Tiras fleet attacked the young nation of Durotar. Fierce battles with the Horde drove many human warships onto jagged shoals, where they broke apart. Barnacled timber, broken rigging, cargo barrels, and sunken ships still mark the coast. For the nearby encampments at Razor Hill, the wreckage recalls how close the Kul Tiran threat remains.

The name Scuttle Coast may refer to warships scuttled or grounded in the fighting, or to crabs and makrura picking through the wreckage. Shoreline beasts and dangerous tides keep casual travelers away.
